text:
About Us
Home
About Us
Who we are
Sulemane Faruk General Trading LLC established in 2013 with the goal to become the best destination for all the Electronics needs.
Emerged as a successfull entrepreneur Sulemane Faruk General Trading LLC is a leading distributor of Toshiba batteries with its head quartered in UAE.
We are a company with high ambitions towards global business in the most possible positive fashion with full of eagerness to hear & understand supplier and customer needs, strive to fulfill it to achieve their satisfaction level at our best.
What we do
With our vast sales & distribution network, robust supply chain, trained and experienced staff and streamlined warehousing & logistic capabilities, we are fully capable of delivering services of the highest quality and standards. We are renowned for offering premium quality products from the best brand TOSHIBA and best in class services to our customers in the GCC, Yemen, India and Bangladesh.
How we do
At Sulemane Faruk General Trading LLC, we serve our customer and supplier with honesty, loyalty and commitment. We pride ourselves in our ethical business practices and customer-centric approach. We operate on the principles of integrity, transparency and professionalism. The company values its customers and is dedicated to provide them with unique products & services that enable them to expand their business and scale it to newer heights. Constant focus on quality and on time delivery service has lead company to achieve remarkable success so far and will emphasize to continue the same.
Our Vision
We possess the resources and expertise to help you grow your business and take it a notch higher!
Sulemane Faruk General Trading LLC is committed to providing its customers and associates with high quality and innovative products and services. Our motto is to become the trusted
distributor for Toshiba product range and to establish a strong foothold in the vast and burgeoning Middle East, South Asian and African market.
We have partnered to expand our Toshiba distribution business in UK, Portugal and Spain through Dubai Based Landmark Group, also working with Carrefour Stores across GCC and already entered in Carrefour Kuwait, we are focusing in our expansion with India, Ruwanda, Mozambique, Angola, Somalia and Sudan.
Our Mission
Our aim is to assist our partners in maximizing their profits by selling and promoting a broad range of best quality products. The company strives to offer quick and reliable after sales support to establish itself as a highly trusted and reputed distributor in the industry. We provide competitive pricing across our range of products as we are the direct dealer of TOSHIBA. We handle all shipments with utmost care and ensure our customers receive it on time ever time.

title: Toshiba Batteries
text:
FAQs
Home
FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
WHERE CAN I GET TOSHIBA BATTERIES?
You can visit any of your local stores (e.g. supermarkets, convenience stores, various retailers of electronic devices etc.). Thanks to our strong distribution network you will probably find TOSHIBA batteries available. In case you cannot find the TOSHIBA brand, please ask your local store to contact us directly.
WHAT SHOULD I BE CAREFUL OF REGARDING BATTERIES?
As batteries contain chemicals, you should:
– Keep them away from children
– Take precautions in case of leakages
– Not set them on fire
– Recycle them, regardless of their chemistry
WHICH BATTERY TYPE SHOULD I USE FOR MY DEVICE?
In order to select the most suitable battery type for your device, please read carefully the instructions given by its manufacturers.
HOW CAN I IMPROVE THE LIFESPAN OF MY BATTERIES?
In order to get the best out of your batteries:
– Turn off the devices when they are not in use
– Remove batteries from devices that you are not using at all
– Store the batteries in a dry place at normal room temperature
– Charge rechargeable batteries only when they are power-off
– Do not mix old and new batteries or different battery types
WHY BATTERIES DO NOT HAVE THE SAME LIFE EXPECTANCY AND POWER OUTPUT?
Because a battery’s life expectancy and power output is directly linked to its chemical composition and its usage.
CAN I RECHARGE ALL BATTERIES?
No, you should only recharge secondary batteries that have a “Rechargeable” indication.
WHAT BATTERY CATEGORIES DO EXIST?
There are two basic battery categories:
1. Primary batteries which are for single use and
2. Secondary (or rechargeable) batteries which are for repeated use.
WHAT IS A BATTERY AND HOW DOES IT WORK?
The first battery was invented by Alessadro Volta in 1800 and since then batteries have become a key power source for many household and industrial applications.
A battery is consisted of one or more electrochemical cells that convert stored chemical energy into electrical energy, through the production and flow of electrons.

title: Toshiba Batteries
text:
FAQs
Home
FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
WHERE CAN I GET TOSHIBA BATTERIES?
You can visit any of your local stores (e.g. supermarkets, convenience stores, various retailers of electronic devices etc.). Thanks to our strong distribution network you will probably find TOSHIBA batteries available. In case you cannot find the TOSHIBA brand, please ask your local store to contact us directly.
WHAT SHOULD I BE CAREFUL OF REGARDING BATTERIES?
As batteries contain chemicals, you should:
– Keep them away from children
– Take precautions in case of leakages
– Not set them on fire
– Recycle them, regardless of their chemistry
WHICH BATTERY TYPE SHOULD I USE FOR MY DEVICE?
In order to select the most suitable battery type for your device, please read carefully the instructions given by its manufacturers.
HOW CAN I IMPROVE THE LIFESPAN OF MY BATTERIES?
In order to get the best out of your batteries:
– Turn off the devices when they are not in use
– Remove batteries from devices that you are not using at all
– Store the batteries in a dry place at normal room temperature
– Charge rechargeable batteries only when they are power-off
– Do not mix old and new batteries or different battery types
WHY BATTERIES DO NOT HAVE THE SAME LIFE EXPECTANCY AND POWER OUTPUT?
Because a battery’s life expectancy and power output is directly linked to its chemical composition and its usage.
CAN I RECHARGE ALL BATTERIES?
No, you should only recharge secondary batteries that have a “Rechargeable” indication.
WHAT BATTERY CATEGORIES DO EXIST?
There are two basic battery categories:
1. Primary batteries which are for single use and
2. Secondary (or rechargeable) batteries which are for repeated use.
WHAT IS A BATTERY AND HOW DOES IT WORK?
The first battery was invented by Alessadro Volta in 1800 and since then batteries have become a key power source for many household and industrial applications.
A battery is consisted of one or more electrochemical cells that convert stored chemical energy into electrical energy, through the production and flow of electrons.
